tasks.title: Record the localization baseline
acceptance: A script in .scratchpad counts catalog entries, interpolation functions, hand plurals, composed template literals, module-scope catalog reads, locale literals, toLocale/Intl sites, toFixed display sites and backend user-facing strings; progress.md records the counts with file lists.
Existing gate failures from other sessions are recorded so later tasks do not attribute them to this work.
A snapshot of every rendered catalog entry (plain values and functions called with fixed sample arguments) is saved for the unchanged-output checks.

tasks.title: Add the catalog runtime and generator
acceptance: intl-messageformat is a dependency of app-core only.
make gen-strings reads locales/en-CA.json and writes the typed accessor and en-XA.json; codegen-check covers both.
activeLocale() is the single entry point, returns en-CA, and switches to en-XA only through a development or test flag.
The accessor resolves each leaf against the active locale at read time and caches compiled messages; unit tests cover caching, argument typing and the pseudo-locale switch.

tasks.title: Move English copy into en-CA.json
acceptance: A codemod moves every plain entry and every function whose body is a single template literal; remaining functions are listed and converted by hand.
Every call site compiles unchanged; app-core, web, mobile, Connect and playground typecheck and tests pass, and the F00 snapshot is identical.

tasks.title: Convert plurals, ordinals and selects to ICU
acceptance: The 95 hand plural checks and the English ordinal array are replaced by ICU plural and selectordinal messages.
English output is unchanged for 0, 1, 2 and 21 in the converted entries.

tasks.title: Move composed sentences into the catalog
acceptance: The roughly 109 template literals that compose copy become whole catalog messages, and the 24 list joins use Intl.ListFormat through the formatter.
No separator literal joins display text outside the catalog; rendered English is unchanged.

tasks.title: Remove module-scope copy
acceptance: Label arrays and maps built at import time become functions or getters.
A test switching to en-XA after import shows every converted label in the pseudo-locale.

tasks.title: Move remaining frontend text into the catalog
acceptance: Copy that F00 found outside strings.ts (domain helpers, stored labels rendered directly, accessibility labels, toUpperCase on copy) reads from the catalog or uses CSS text-transform.
Subject attribute values stored as English words (pet temperaments) are rendered through a catalog lookup keyed by the stored value, with no data change.

tasks.title: Build the formatter module
acceptance: Money, number, percent, date, time, range, relative time, list and duration formatting use Intl with activeLocale(), an explicit currency and an explicit time zone.
No function has a locale default; tests cover en-CA and en-XA output, negative amounts and a non-CAD currency.

tasks.title: Replace direct formatting call sites
acceptance: The roughly 30 locale literals, 42 toLocale/Intl sites and 74 toFixed display sites go through the formatter.
formatMoney takes the currency of the amount; English output is unchanged for CAD.

tasks.title: Make money and number input locale-aware
acceptance: parseCents and number parsing read the active locale's decimal and grouping separators and currency position from Intl.
Existing money and number field tests pass; new tests cover grouping separators and a locale with a comma decimal using Intl data only.

tasks.title: Use the business time zone in the apps
acceptance: Display and day grouping use the business time zone, including the SQL date expressions in app-core.
app-core tests pass under America/Vancouver, America/Halifax and Asia/Tokyo; Hermes output is checked on iOS and Android.

tasks.title: Use the business time zone on Connect
acceptance: Booking times and all public dates are in the business zone, with a zone label when the visitor's zone differs.
A Playwright run with a browser time zone different from the business shows correct times and the label.

tasks.title: Take hour cycle and week start from the locale
acceptance: Time pickers, clock options and calendars read hour cycle and first day of week through the formatter.
English output stays 12-hour with a Monday-first week.

tasks.title: Add the backend catalog
acceptance: Babel is a dependency; core/locale.py loads en_CA.po, exposes locale_for(...) returning en_CA, a typed message lookup and Babel formatters.
make gen-messages regenerates messages.pot and en_XA.po; codegen-check covers both; ruff and mypy strict pass.

tasks.title: Move notification copy into the catalog
acceptance: All 38 builders read messages through the catalog using locale_for(...).
Tests render every builder in en_XA with no unconverted text; English output is unchanged apart from F33.

tasks.title: Move remaining backend copy into the catalog
acceptance: Auth and staff emails and the SMS opt-out line come from the catalog.
Inbound opt-out words are unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix backend money and date formatting
acceptance: _money is replaced by Babel currency formatting with the amount's currency; negative amounts and thousands separators are correct.
Dates use Babel in the business time zone and match the app's English format; the hardcoded CAD in estimate and gift card messages is removed.
Tests cover each fix.

tasks.title: Render tax labels from jurisdiction codes
acceptance: Tax display names and registration labels come from the catalogs, keyed by GST, HST, PST and QST.
If any English tax name is stored in a table, it is reported in progress.md and left in place; no schema change.

tasks.title: Enforce the error contract
acceptance: Every client-visible failure maps a stable error code or status to a catalog message.
No client renders an API error message; a test covers the mapping for each code.

tasks.title: Localize CSV exports and validate time zones
acceptance: Report CSV headers come from the catalog; column order and data are unchanged.
Invalid IANA time zone names are rejected with a typed error, existing rows are checked and reported, and the business screen offers a time zone picker.

tasks.title: Localize printed documents
acceptance: Invoices, estimates, receipts and signed contracts take titles, page counters, tax labels and amounts from the catalog and formatter.
Printed output in en-CA is unchanged; en-XA shows no unconverted text.

tasks.title: Move mobile permission prompts into native files
acceptance: Permission prompts and the display name come from English native locale files; CFBundleLocalizations and the Android locale config declare en.
The iOS simulator and Android emulator builds show the same prompts as before.

tasks.title: Build the embed script from the catalog
acceptance: embed.js is generated from source with its strings from the catalog; codegen-check fails when it is stale.
The embed dialog renders the same English titles and close label.

tasks.title: Move marketing site prose into a catalog
acceptance: Site prose lives in apps/site/locales/en-CA.json with the same generator; structural data stays in TypeScript.
The site's money formatter is replaced by the shared formatter; lint:content and test-site pass with unchanged pages.

tasks.title: Add the frontend lint rules
acceptance: no-raw-format, no-composed-copy, no-module-scope-copy, no-hand-plural and no-error-message-copy are active with tests and a recorded false-positive count.
no-inline-ui-string also covers the embed source and site components; pnpm lint passes.

tasks.title: Add catalog checks
acceptance: check-catalogs validates ICU syntax, argument lists against placeholders, and unused keys for both app and site catalogs.
It runs in make check and CI.

tasks.title: Add backend copy checks
acceptance: Literal or f-string text passed to senders, CSV writers or client-visible errors outside the catalog fails make lint.
messages.pot and en_XA.po staleness fail codegen-check.

tasks.title: Run the pseudo-locale e2e suite
acceptance: Playground stories and key web and Connect pages run in en-XA and fail on unmarked visible text.
The suite runs in CI.

tasks.title: Fix layouts for longer text
acceptance: The roughly 92 fixed widths and 256 truncation points are reviewed in en-XA; clipped controls, badges and stat tiles are fixed on web, iOS and Android without changing the English layout.

tasks.title: Add the time zone test matrix
acceptance: CI runs app-core tests under three TZ values and formatter tests under en-CA and en-XA.

tasks.title: Update the conventions and close
acceptance: The Copy section describes the catalog format, the formatter rule, the pseudo-locale and the gate; architecture.md describes activeLocale(), locale_for(...) and the time zone rule.
make check, the playground suite and manual en-XA passes on web, iOS and Android are green and recorded.
